title: Banno Pulse
description: Financial wellness command center — accounts, activity, insights, goals, and documents.

notes.initialHeight: Set this value in Banno People → Plugin configuration → Initial height. Must match PLUGIN_INITIAL_HEIGHT in wrangler.jsonc.
notes.recommendedRange: Jack Henry recommends 200–400px for parity with other dashboard cards. We use 600px to fit the tabbed dashboard without excessive cropping.
notes.responsive: Card-face width on mobile is typically 264–336px. The app CSS is tuned for that range.
